description: Angular component for rendering and interacting with rule nodes in the Thingsboard UI, including navigation and tooltip display.

classes.name: RuleNodeComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending FcNodeComponent to display and manage rule nodes, including icon handling, navigation, and tooltips.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, setting icon URL if available.

methods.name: openRuleChain
methods.description: Navigates to the specified rule chain based on node configuration and type.

methods.name: displayOpenRuleChainTooltip
methods.description: Displays a tooltip with information about opening the rule chain.
